# telnyx_notification_profile (Resource)

A notification profile, which groups the notification channels that account notifications are sent to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_notification_profile" "ops" {
  name = "Operations"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) A human readable name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the notification profile.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_notification_profile.ops <id>
```
